notes: Mobile self-service now runs on its own dedicated port (18082) instead of being distinguished by IP-matching on the same port as the admin UI (18080) -- fixes a bug where a fresh single-NIC box's only reachable IP (the LAN-phone gateway) made the admin UI unreachable, always showing mobile.html instead. Accessing the router's gateway IP on port 80 always shows mobile self-service; port 18080 always shows the admin UI.
